title: L'attente de Jean Reno  (Waiting for Jean Reno)

segments.t: In Andrea's office at ASK, tensions run high as Gabriel reports another devastating financing rejection for Xavier Beauvois's script. Just as their hopes seem completely dashed, unexpected news arrives that movie star Jean Reno is heading to the agency. Let's listen to their conversation in French first.
Je ne comprends pas son refus.
Tu avais presque réussi à le convaincre?
Oui, et au dernier moment, il refuse.
Il t'a donné une raison précise?
Non, il reste muet comme une tombe.
Alors c'est terminé avec lui.
Laisse tomber, c'est trop tard.
Nous avons besoin d'un grand acteur.
Jean Reno sera bientôt là!
Jean Reno arrive vraiment à l'agence?
Oui, il est en route maintenant.
C'est notre dernière chance de survie.
Il adore déjà le beau scénario.
Préparons son accueil avec grand soin.
Let's look at Gabriel and Andrea preparing for their crucial meeting step by step.
Je ne comprends pas son refus.
'I do not understand his refusal.' Gabriel expresses bewilderment at the financier's rejection.
Tu avais presque réussi à le convaincre?
'You had almost managed to convince him?' Andrea confirms how close they came to a deal.
Oui, et au dernier moment, il refuse.
'Yes, and at the last moment, he refuses.' Gabriel describes the investor pulling out abruptly.
Il t'a donné une raison précise?
'Did he give you a specific reason?' Andrea asks if any motive was provided.
Non, il reste muet comme une tombe.
'No, he remains silent as a grave.' Gabriel uses a vivid idiom to indicate total silence.
Alors c'est terminé avec lui.
'Then it is over with him.' Andrea moves on from the lost opportunity.
Laisse tomber, c'est trop tard.
'Forget it, it is too late.' Gabriel cautions against wasting further energy.
Nous avons besoin d'un grand acteur.
'We need a great actor.' Andrea identifies the key element needed to revive the film.
Jean Reno sera bientôt là!
'Jean Reno will be here soon!' Gabriel announces that a legendary star is arriving.
Jean Reno arrive vraiment à l'agence?
'Jean Reno is really coming to the agency?' Andrea verifies the astonishing news.
Oui, il est en route maintenant.
'Yes, he is on his way now.' Gabriel reassures her that the actor is traveling to ASK.
C'est notre dernière chance de survie.
'It is our last chance of survival.' Andrea stresses the existential stakes for the firm.
Il adore déjà le beau scénario.
'He already loves the beautiful script.' Gabriel builds confidence ahead of the pitch.
Préparons son accueil avec grand soin.
'Let us prepare his welcome with great care.' Andrea prepares to give the star their utmost focus. Now listen to the whole scene again at normal speed, and see how much more you catch.

Crushed by another funding rejection, Andrea and Gabriel suddenly find new hope when legendary actor Jean Reno agrees to visit ASK to discuss Xavier Beauvois's screenplay.
Oui, il est en route maintenant.
